text: I stood on a stage wearing a mask. Behind the curtain was a locked room and a shadow moved near the door.
The mask cracked in a mirror. A child waited by a stairway and pointed toward an unopened room.
I entered the room and found a window, a road, and a guide holding a map.
The house had a center with a tree growing through the floor. The mask was gone.
A snake followed me through a house. I ran into a room with no window.
The snake became an animal guarding a door. I felt fear but did not run.
A stranger opened the door and showed me a river beside a road.
The animal walked beside me on the path and the shadow became smaller.
Water rose in a hallway and flooded the house. I tried to speak but no sound came.
The flood carried a broken vessel toward a child standing on a bridge.
Rain entered the room and washed the mirror. I saw a guide outside.
The river became calm. A road appeared beside the water and a tree stood near the shore.
The city was dark and I lost my compass. A stone circle appeared beneath the street.
A star reflected in a pool. I found a temple below the road.
Inside the temple was a center, a tree, and a quiet child.
The darkness lifted and a road led from the circle toward dawn.
I was late for work and forgot my shoes. A dog waited by the door.
I returned to the office but found a garden instead of a desk.
A familiar colleague became a stranger and handed me a key.
The key opened a small room with a window and a chair.
A bridge crossed dark water but the path was broken. I heard a guide calling from the other side.
The bridge was repaired with wood and stone. A child carried a seed across the water.
A garden appeared near the road. Dawn light touched a gate.
I crossed the bridge and found a circular temple with a tree at the center.
